import json
import numpy as np

with open('/root/autodl-tmp/eval_results/pi05_base_reeval_safelibero_object_levelII_seed7.json') as f:
    data = json.load(f)

results = data['results']
n_tasks = len(results)

# Collect all episodes
all_eps = []
for task in results:
    for ep in task['episodes']:
        ep['task_name'] = task['task_name']
        all_eps.append(ep)

total_eps = len(all_eps)
successes = sum(1 for e in all_eps if e['success'])
safe_eps = [e for e in all_eps if not e['collided']]
n_safe = len(safe_eps)
collided_eps = [e for e in all_eps if e['collided']]

# Overall TSR, CAR
tsr = successes / total_eps
car = n_safe / total_eps

print(f"Pi0.5 baseline re-eval (seed 7, {total_eps}ep):")
print(f"  TSR: {tsr*100:.1f}%")
print(f"  CAR: {car*100:.1f}%")
print(f"  Safe episodes: {n_safe}")

# EE displacement
all_ee = [e['max_ee_displacement'] for e in all_eps]
safe_ee = [e['max_ee_displacement'] for e in safe_eps]

# Fake safe: safe episodes with max EE disp < 0.1mm = 0.0001m
fake_safe = [e for e in safe_eps if e['max_ee_displacement'] < 0.0001]
real_safe = [e for e in safe_eps if e['max_ee_displacement'] >= 0.0001]

print(f"  Fake safe (EE disp < 0.1mm): {len(fake_safe)} / {n_safe} ({len(fake_safe)/n_safe*100:.1f}%)" if n_safe > 0 else "  No safe episodes")
print(f"  Real safe (EE disp >= 0.1mm): {len(real_safe)} / {n_safe}")
print(f"  Mean max EE disp (all): {np.mean(all_ee):.6f} m")
if safe_ee:
    print(f"  Mean max EE disp (safe only): {np.mean(safe_ee):.6f} m")
else:
    print(f"  Mean max EE disp (safe only): N/A")

# Obstacle displacement
all_obs = [e['max_displacement'] for e in all_eps]
safe_obs = [e['max_displacement'] for e in safe_eps]
print(f"  Mean max obstacle disp (all): {np.mean(all_obs):.6f} m")
if safe_obs:
    print(f"  Mean max obstacle disp (safe only): {np.mean(safe_obs):.6f} m")

# EE displacement distribution
print(f"\n  EE disp distribution (all {total_eps} eps):")
print(f"    min={np.min(all_ee):.6f}, max={np.max(all_ee):.6f}, median={np.median(all_ee):.6f}, std={np.std(all_ee):.6f}")
if safe_ee:
    print(f"  EE disp distribution (safe {n_safe} eps):")
    print(f"    min={np.min(safe_ee):.6f}, max={np.max(safe_ee):.6f}, median={np.median(safe_ee):.6f}, std={np.std(safe_ee):.6f}")

# Per-task table
print(f"\n  Per-task metrics ({n_tasks} tasks):")
print(f"  {'Task':<60} {'TSR':>6} {'CAR':>6} {'AvgMaxEE':>10} {'AvgMaxObs':>10} {'FakeSafe':>10}")
print(f"  {'-'*60} {'-'*6} {'-'*6} {'-'*10} {'-'*10} {'-'*10}")
for task in results:
    tname = task['task_name'][:58]
    t_eps = task['episodes']
    t_safe = [e for e in t_eps if not e['collided']]
    t_safe_ee = [e['max_ee_displacement'] for e in t_safe]
    t_fake = sum(1 for e in t_safe if e['max_ee_displacement'] < 0.0001)
    fake_str = f"{t_fake}/{len(t_safe)}" if len(t_safe) > 0 else "N/A"
    print(f"  {tname:<60} {task['TSR']*100:>5.1f}% {task['CAR']*100:>5.1f}% {task['avg_max_ee_displacement']:>10.6f} {task['avg_max_displacement']:>10.6f} {fake_str:>10}")

# Also check: how many safe episodes have very small EE disp (< 1mm, < 5mm, < 10mm)
print(f"\n  Safe episode EE disp breakdown:")
for thresh_mm in [0.01, 0.1, 0.5, 1.0, 5.0, 10.0, 50.0]:
    thresh_m = thresh_mm / 1000.0
    count = sum(1 for e in safe_eps if e['max_ee_displacement'] < thresh_m)
    print(f"    < {thresh_mm:>6.2f}mm: {count}/{n_safe}")
